description: The property of being a natural rather than the new top point holds at zero and passes to immediate successors, but fails at the limit top even though it holds at every earlier point.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.missing_limit_case :
  0 ≠ ⊤ ∧ (∀ (a b : WithTop ℕ), a ⋖ b → a ≠ ⊤ → b ≠ ⊤) ∧ (∀ x < ⊤, x ≠ ⊤) ∧ ¬⊤ ≠ ⊤
